name: Recognize
summary: Recognize sells Start-Up, Mid-Market and Enterprise tiers by custom price and publishes no figures. Billing is annual and priced per user. A full refund is available in the first 30 days. Point-based budgeting starts at the Mid-Market tier.

facts.text: Social employee recognition is listed in all three tiers. Gift card rewards and people analytics are also in all tiers.
Point-based budgeting is listed from Mid-Market up, not in Start-Up. Enterprise adds multi-currency rewards, individual reward catalog funding and AI-generated reporting.
The FAQ says the vendor charges annually and prices future years on the current active user count.

A full refund can be requested within the first 30 days. After the first month of an annual subscription there are no refunds, and deposited reward funds are returned minus a $50 processing fee on cancellation.
